# Widget Co. IT Security Policy (Excerpt)

This is a fictional internal document used as a local test fixture. Its
facts are invented and deliberately specific, so a retrieval-quality eval
can tell a correctly-retrieved answer apart from something the LLM
already "knew" on its own.

## Password Policy

All employee account passwords must be rotated every 90 days and must be
at least 14 characters. Multi-factor authentication is required for every
account with access to production systems, with no exceptions.

## Incident Response

A reported security incident must be triaged within 4 hours during
business hours, or within 12 hours outside business hours. Any incident
classified as Severity 1 must be escalated to the CISO within 30 minutes
of triage.

## Device Policy

Company-issued laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled and must
check in with the device management system at least once every 7 days.
A device that misses two consecutive check-ins is automatically locked
out of the corporate VPN.

## Data Retention

Security incident logs are retained for 3 years. Access logs for
production systems are retained for 1 year, after which they are
automatically purged.
